h: וַיֵּלֶךְ וְשַׁבָּת תְּשׁוּבָה, ג׳ Vayeilech and Shabbos Shuvah, 3

p: in the Midrash Tanchuma cited above:
It was written on the arm
וְעַל כֵּן יָבִין וְיַשְׂכִּיל כָּל אָדָם
and therefore let every person understand and comprehend,
with his knowledge and his intellect,
to meditate in the Torah day and night, etc.,
We must understand the wording "and therefore let him understand":
what sort of reason is this,
עַל זְרוֹעוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא?
on the arm of HaKadosh Baruch Hu?
But the matter is as it is stated
"'By His right hand' — this is the Torah, etc.;
'and by the arm of His strength' — these are tefillin, etc.";
that which is called "'By His right hand' — this is the Torah"
as it is written, "From His right hand, a fiery law for them"
And likewise, that which is called
"'the arm of His strength' — these are tefillin"
is also from the side of Yisrael,
through the tefillin of the head,
which is the sum of the whole Torah.
And this gives strength, as it were,
in the manner of what is said,
But before the Torah was given
it was written on His arm,
and was not then specifically in His right hand.
And so it is expounded in the Gemara
"Hashem will give strength to His people"
that is, at that time the Torah was
His instrument of craft and His delight,
and it was not yet called "Torah,"
as they said in the Midrash above.
that is, to draw down the light
And this is why it says "let him understand,"
"with his knowledge" — this is the aspect of Da'as.
which preceded the creation of the world
(as was explained in the previous maamar);
and the light "that it was good,"
which is the tip of the supernal Yud,
"to meditate in the Torah day and night":
that is, that even at night, in sleep,
he will merit words of Torah.
And this is the essence of the aspect of
who merited all of the lower wisdom,
in a dream of the night.
וְהוּא עַל יְדֵי שֶׁיִּהְיֶה קָשׁוּר בַּשּׁוֹרֶשׁ,
This comes through his being bound to the root
And it says, "and in good deeds":
that one who did not merit Torah,
to meditate in it day and night,
the three uppermost sefiros as well,
"The beginning of wisdom is the fear of Hashem;
good understanding to all who do them"
"'to those who learn them' is not said,
according to the reading of the Ein Yaakov).
"The fear of Hashem" — this is teshuvah
"Good" — this is the light "that it was good,"
that was hidden away for those who toil in Torah she'b'al peh
And this is why the Midrash afterward brings
the pasuk, "For it is near to you, etc.,
in your mouth and in your heart, to do it"
"in your heart" — this is "Binah is the heart";
And all this serves to explain
which refers to Torah she'b'al peh
and this power he handed over to Yisrael.
"And if he did not learn as much as he needed,
let him do his deeds with faithfulness.
he said to him: Understanding and knowledge
that were given to me from Heaven, etc.;
and it is written, 'For the matter is very near to you,
in your mouth and in your heart, to do it,' etc.;
and the end of the matter is the fear of Hashem
and he is worthy of the life of Olam Haba."
To understand how this belongs here:
it is based on what they said in the Midrash
at the beginning of this parashah:
"'Vayeilech' is nothing but an expression of rebuke,
as it is said, 'Go, behold the works of Hashem'"
But the matter is based on
what they said in the Gemara
that a person should choose for himself, etc.?
for as long as there are rebukes in the world,
goodness and blessing come to the world,
let him hold fast to abundant faithfulness, etc."
And these are found in the holiness of Shabbos as well.
"HaKadosh Baruch Hu said to His world:
would that you find favor before Me
just as you have found favor before Me
"And what was created on it after He rested?
"Blessing" — it is stated explicitly about it,
as it is written, "And Elokim blessed
as in 'For I have given you good teaching'"
and this is the Written Torah;
"The Torah of Your mouth is good to me"
all agree that the Torah was given on Shabbos
for Shabbos is the attribute of Malchus,
And this is what is said,
there they are written only with the Name Havayah,
which is the Name of mercy.
And afterward, in Parashas Nitzavim, is written
and that is the true perfection:
that the Name Havayah will be
as it will be in the future,
as it is said, "And there will be no survivor of the house of Esav"
and it is written, "Hashem alone will lead him"
And all the rebukes are only
(as is written in Zohar Chadash, Savo,
and as has been explained many times).
And this is what is said above this pasuk:
He gave forth His voice, the earth melted"
"and there will be no survivor of the house of Esav."
And afterward it is written, "Hashem Tzevaos":
in Havayah, the Vav alludes to Tiferes,
of which Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
"Tzevaos" — we find that it alludes to Yesod
the filling of the Name Shakkai —
י"ן ל"ת ו"ד – עוֹלֶה חֲמֵשׁ מֵאוֹת,
Yud-Nun, Lamed-Tav, Vav-Dalet — which amounts to five hundred,
and so does "Tzevaos" with the kollel
And this is what is said, "Hashem Tzevaos is with us":
that is, the Vav together with the Vav of the filling,
that even according to the attribute of judgment,
like Adam HaRishon before the corruption,
and his attribute is "the lip of truth
And this is why it says "Selah,"
as they said in the Gemara
And after this comes the pasuk,
are only with mercy, as stated.
"Who has wrought desolations in the land" —
as it is written, "Hashem alone will lead him";
and this will be close to the seventh millennium,
the day that is entirely Shabbos.
And this is what they said in the Gemara cited above:
that a person should choose for himself?"
that the heart will be made entirely straight,
as it will be in the days of Mashiach,
in which there is no yetzer hara
And this is what is said: "Go" —
for this is the straight path;
"Prophecy is called by ten terms, etc.;
as it is said, 'A harsh vision has been told to me'"
Nevertheless, they are works of Hashem,
for they are only a loud roar
so as to bring him back to the good,
so that through this they will merit
the days of Mashiach and Olam Haba,
when He will be called "Havayah your God."
נַחַת רוּחַ וְטוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה בָּאִין לָעוֹלָם,
contentment, goodness and blessing come to the world,
and the opposite departs from the world.
וְזֶה קוֹנִין עַל יְדֵי דִּבְרֵי תּוֹרָה,
And this is acquired through words of Torah,
And this is what it says in the Tanchuma there,
were you not given understanding, etc.?
'For it is near, etc., in your mouth and in your heart'" —
and "to do it" — that is, good deeds.
And this is what it says,
"And if he did not learn as much as he needed,
let him do his deeds with faithfulness" —
this is what they said there in the Gemara:
let him hold fast to abundant faithfulness,
as it is said, 'My eyes are upon the faithful of the land,
that they may dwell with Me'"
And when it says "to dwell with Me" —
and there, there is nothing but the light of Torah,
with which HaKadosh Baruch Hu wrapped Himself as with a garment
corresponding to the five Chumashim of the Torah —
only Hashem Yisbarach has the power
to make shine forth even in an am ha'aretz
And this is why it says "immadi"
rather, as is written in the holy Zohar
and once it was impregnated with the Yud
that is, the Yud is Chochmah.
And this is what it says in the Tanchuma cited above:
"And the end of the matter is the fear of Hashem
and he is worthy of the life of Olam Haba" —
this is in the manner of what they said
"May you see your world in your lifetime,"
meaning that he will merit to attain Olam Haba in his lifetime.
וְהוּא גַּם כֵּן נַחַת רוּחַ, טוֹבָה וּבְרָכָה,
And this too is contentment, goodness and blessing,
And this is the connection to the exposition,
"'Vayeilech' is nothing but an expression of rebuke,"
